blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A fisherfolk group held a protest Tuesday morning against another round of fuel price increases, which it said would further burden small-scale fishers just as they begin returning to sea after more than three months of disrupted operations due to the southwest monsoon, or habagat. Members of the Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (Pamalakaya) staged a coastal protest in Manila Bay to denounce the latest fuel price increases.
